summary: Backend-only validation completed for Internal Data AI auxiliary query fixes. Requested local suite passed (22/22). Live authenticated run with a single admin login executed the four required questions and all passed expected routing and answer checks.
critical_code_review_comments: services/brsr.py: submission status map is not period-filtered before merge; if question_key is reused across periods, approval status can bleed from another period. Consider period-constrained submission selection keyed by (question_key, period).

services/history.py:get_pending_status currently reports awaiting_approval as len(pending requests), not unique entity_id count; duplicate pending requests for same record could inflate counts. Consider dedup by entity_id for user-facing 'entries' semantics.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 163 validated the reported auxiliary query regressions end-to-end on live /api/internal-ai/chat with one admin login and four required prompts. All query_type checks passed: calculation_property_lookup, brsr_lookup, approval_status_lookup, evidence_lookup. Local month alias parsing tests for 'aug' and 'sept' also passed in focused suite.
rca of the issue: Previously observed PENDING-style failures were tied to intent/query-type routing and period normalization gaps. Current behavior is corrected: explicit routes now dispatch to dedicated services (calculation_properties/brsr/approvals/evidence), and month aliases ('aug', 'sept') resolve deterministically to calendar months used in downstream filters.
